name: El Frasno (Spain)
description: White field with a red saltire, charged at the centre with a blue octagon bearing a yellow plant above a shield of the bars of Aragon.
history: Municipal flag of El Frasno; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: plant and small shield of the bars of Aragon on the octagon
